title: Production administrator authority
text: A *-db-admin connection runs each handler on the operator's machine against the database over a tunnel, 10-75x slower than its paired https env. Routine operations use --env <https env>; any other registered call through the door refuses use_https_env and names that env. The door keeps only db read diagnostics, doctor, migration content identity, operator data repair, migration rehearsal, driving a self-deploy of the paired API and creation bootstrap, listed once in yoke_contracts.direct_database_access.
